title: Middle C and the beat
trains: The five lines are the staff; the treble clef starts it. Middle C, the C nearest the middle of the keyboard, sits on a short line below it: play it with your right thumb (finger 1). A quarter note (filled head, stem) is one beat; 4/4 means four beats per bar.
